title.es: Yate moderno con cubierta de arenisca
title.pt: Iate moderno com convés de arenito

generated.description: A modern white-and-sandstone yacht floating on water, with a stepped hull, quartz and sandstone decks, gray-tinted glass windows, and birch plank interiors. It measures about 78 blocks wide, 26 high and 27 deep, and is built from roughly 16,600 blocks, mostly water. Interior rooms include furnaces, hoppers, flower pots and signs for small details.
